releases.notes:
- Dropped support for modded items and previous Minecraft versions due to Mojang changing sh*t for no reason (see below)
- Fixed some errors I'd missed causing some recipes to not load (thank you gamintoomuch on Discord for helping the progress along)
- Double the cooking times for blasted and smelted recipes in accordance with the 26.3 changes

In Minecraft 26.3-snapshot-3 Mojang essentially removed my ability to support mods and previous Minecraft versions in my datapacks. Before 26.3-snapshot-3 Minecraft would ignore references to items that didn't exist when loading a datapack. I used this so that I could add recipes for modded items and items that had their names changed (like chain -> iron_chain). Now when a recipe references items that don't exist, the world refuses to load. Because of this, I can no longer support mods or previous versions of Minecraft effectively. In the future, I will see if I can continue modded item support and previous MC version support by creating a mod.

releases.notes:
Added smelting recipes for all variants of:
Copper Chest
Copper Golem Statue
Copper Bars
Copper Chains
Copper Lanterns
Copper Tools
Copper Weapons
Copper Armor
Lightning Rod
New Nautilus Armor

Added recipes for the Spear (copper tier and above)
Added recipe for Netherite Horse Armor

Fixed iron chains smelting recipe not working in 1.21.9+ due to rename
Added backport of iron lantern and soul lantern smelting recipe to match the new copper lantern smelting
Fixed an error that's been in the datapack for who knows how long causing smelting recipes to not be visible in-game (im so sorry)
Fixed nothing being able to smelt into iron nuggets in 1.21.9+
Reduced errors thrown by the datapack down to 1 in most cases
Fixed some iron nugget recipes breaking due to outdated tag references
Probably did other stuff too
